en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a large Gothic-style church with a tall steeple, most likely a well-known landmark in the city. Tree branches frame the image, with a body of water or canal in the foreground. The word 'Sundsvall' and 'Kyrkan' are printed in red at the bottom left, indicating the city and the church depicted. There is handwritten text on the image and on the reverse side, alongside an old Swedish postage stamp and a dated postmark (13.11.02). The recipient's address is in Stockholm.
